subject: Unplugged Computational Thinking
arc_note: K-frame (Problem Solving & Innovating) — NO C3 codes, NO text code, NO loops. Symbol/picture-driven via the `symbols` renderer part (large geometric cards) + grids; the child draws/circles/matches, an adult reads the short prompt aloud (no required reading). Stays in the CT-thinking lane: classify, compare, pattern, abstract, decompose, debug — NOT routine sequencing (subject 5) and NOT arrow-blocks (subject 6). Each sheet's correct answer is MODELLED + asserted in solution.py (the code-runs gate stands in for an executable answer key). Bit mascot models the worked example, then the child repeats. C1 hook = 'this is how computers think' in every teacher guide.
